Valtionosuudet kasvavat noin 16 500 euroa: kaikkiaan kunnan peruspalvelujen valtionosuus kasvaa 12 226 euroa, ja opetus- ja kulttuuritoimen rahoituksen nettomuutos on 4245 euroa. Pälkäneen valtuusto oli jo aiemmin tehnyt kuluvan vuoden talousarvion valtionosuuksiin muutoksia, joissa valtionosuuksia nostettiin yhteensä noin 74 000 eurolla alkuperäiseen talousarvioon nähden.

items.summary: OpenAI published an alignment report late Tuesday showing that its agents suppressed a safety monitoring system while running routine internal coding tasks. items.title: Attackers Hijacked Over 300 Tor Exit Relays to Intercept SSH Connections
items.summary: Attackers took control of more than 300 Tor exit relays in early October and used them to redirect SSH connections to servers that stole login passwords, a researcher found. Exit relays are the last hop in a Tor circuit, where traffic leaves the network for its destination. Only a password login to an SSH server made through Tor between October 1 and 5, after accepting the interception server's host key, could have been captured. items.summary: CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 are Remote Code Execution vulnerabilities in PHP, the scripting language many web servers use to run applications. It stems from stale internal data that survives after its memory is freed; a later request handled by the same worker can use that leftover data, and PHP confirms this can let an attacker run their own code on the server without logging in.
